howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From inquiry to delivery — our streamlined process

1.title: Submit Your Inquiry
1.desc: Fill out our inquiry form with your peptide specifications, quantity, and project details.

2.title: Receive Your Quote
2.desc: Our team reviews your requirements and sends a detailed quote within 24 hours.

3.title: Confirm & Synthesize
3.desc: Upon approval, our scientists begin synthesis using state-of-the-art SPPS technology.

4.title: Quality Testing
4.desc: Each batch undergoes rigorous HPLC and mass spectrometry analysis to verify purity.

5.title: Delivery
5.desc: Your peptides are shipped with cold-chain logistics and full documentation.
